Additionally, Losartan is linked to Captopril, an antihypertensive agent that binds to Ace, further reinforcing a possible role for Ace in the metabolism or action of Captopril. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible mechanism by which Losartan influences Ace's activity, though the exact nature of this interaction remains unclear. The evidence points to a dependency on chloride ion transport, suggesting that Ace may play a role in the physiological effects of Losartan, though the precise mechanism requires further investigation.
